name: android-emulator
description: Provides Android development workflows and emulator automation for ZCode.

sdk_path.description: Optional Android SDK root directory. When empty, falls back to ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, or common system paths.

api_level.description: Android API level used when generating projects, installing SDK packages, and selecting the default system image.

build_tools_version.description: Android SDK build-tools version used in installation guidance.

system_image_variant.description: Android system image variant: default, google_apis, or google_apis_playstore.

system_image_abi.description: Optional Android system image ABI override. When empty, Apple Silicon/ARM64 hosts use arm64-v8a and other hosts use x86_64.

jdk_major.description: JDK major version used for preflight checks and installation guidance.
